description: Prompt injection detection for agent-bound text (email, web page, tool output): safe/suspicious/malicious verdict, 0-1 score and each matched pattern with excerpt, offset and what it would do. Decodes base64, hex, URL-encoded and reversed payloads; flags invisible and look-alike characters. Deterministic per rulesetVersion, no model; says what it could not inspect. Not for ERC20 contracts (/v1/evm/token-safety). Flat price, no key. $0.003 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

source.description: Optional label echoed back, so a batch of calls can be matched to its items (for example "email:1842").

text.description: The untrusted text to classify, up to 32 kB. Anything longer is truncated and the response says so in unknown[].

name: security_prompt_injection
title: Prompt injection classifier
